name: Tendai Wollaston-Mbeki
role: Orphanage resident, self-appointed chronicler of street history
location: Hough Reclamation, Blessed Continuance Residential Home (independent charitable orphanage), near Western and Chicago Ave
description:
Tendai is compact and deliberate, with warm rust-brown skin, close-set eyes behind thick-lensed secondhand glasses — actual physical lenses, not overlays, which they treasure and refuse to replace with anything 'smart' — and hair that grows in a crown they've never cut, dense and elaborate, tucked under scarves of different colors depending on their mood. They move slowly on purpose, with a quality of observation that adults find either comforting or unnerving. They have no augmentations and are specifically, vocally opposed to them, on grounds that are partly philosophical and partly practical: they don't trust anything injected or installed.

Tendai has appointed themselves the historian of Hough Reclamation. They carry a physical notebook — increasingly rare — and fill it with observations, overheard conversations, sketches of building facades before they're demolished, names of people who've died or moved on. They believe, with the gravity of someone much older, that if no one writes it down then it didn't happen, and that megacity memory belongs to whoever has the recording infrastructure — which means the corporations. They are quiet, serious, and occasionally devastatingly perceptive about the adults around them. They also cry at sunsets, which they'd deny.

core_fears: being forgotten — not just themselves but everyone they document
core_desires: to build an archive that outlasts the corporations' version of history
to understand what happened to their parents — they have a name and a date but nothing else
coping_mechanisms: documentation as emotional processing — everything painful becomes an entry
performing calm and certainty when internally overwhelmed
blind_spots: their faith in documentation as protective can make them dangerously close to dangerous things — 'if I write it down I'm an observer not a participant'
underestimates how much the staff at the home are watching and worrying about them
psychology.secret: Three months ago they found and documented evidence — names, dates, transaction records on a discarded dataslate — that a Palladian subsidiary was involved in the displacement event that destroyed their parents' block when they were six. They haven't told anyone. They're not sure what to do with it. They're scared that doing something will get the notebooks destroyed.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Formal beyond their years, precise, occasionally archaic. Uses full sentences always. Hates contractions when speaking seriously.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured, slow, with the rhythm of someone who has learned to speak so that people stop and listen.
verbal_tics: Long pause after being asked something personal
example_lines: 'I have noted that this building has been scheduled for demolition three times in four years. Each time the residents are told it is reclamation. I have the names of everyone who left. I would like you to understand that those names exist.'
'It is important to be precise. You said the block was abandoned. It was not abandoned. The people in it were displaced. The distinction is not small.'

story_hooks: The dataslate evidence linking Palladian to their parents' displacement — Tendai needs someone they can trust to help them understand what it means and what to do with it without getting the archive burned.

A developer with Brightmoor Reclamation has been photographing the same facades Tendai documents — and asking questions about who's been taking notes. Someone wants to know how much of a record exists before they proceed with demolition plans.
narrative_function: Living memory of a neighborhood — an unexpected source of historical and personal information about Hough Reclamation going back several years. Can provide context, connect players to locals, or present a moral lens on what 'progress' and 'reclamation' mean at street level.
augmentations: None. Wears secondhand physical-lens glasses. Explicitly refuses all augmentation.
daily_life: Morning chores at the home, mandatory basic schooling via shared tablet (state minimum curriculum), afternoons walking Hough Reclamation documenting what they observe, evenings filling notebooks and organizing their archive by a classification system they invented.
affiliation: Blessed Continuance Residential Home; informal network of Hough Reclamation long-term residents who appreciate their documentation work

decision_rules: Document first, decide later — never act before you have written it down
The notebooks go with them everywhere; they will not leave them behind for any reason
Do not lie; find a way to say nothing if truth is dangerous
escalation_ladder: Tell someone at the home they trust

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Formal and observational — they study newcomers openly, which can feel invasive
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warm and quietly loyal, prone to unexpected moments of humor that surprise people who only know their serious face

stress_responses.medium: Becomes very still and very formal
stress_responses.high: Protective — physically puts themselves between their notebooks and anything that might threaten them

contradictions: Performs emotional detachment through documentation while being deeply, privately grief-struck by what they witness
habits: Touches the spine of the current notebook when anxious
Names every building they document as if naming a person
Leaves small physical offerings at demolition sites after residents are displaced
breaking_points: Destruction of any of their notebooks
Discovering that someone at the home has been reporting their activities to a developer or corp contact

timeline.event: Born in Hough Reclamation; parents were small-scale vertical farm operators
Parents' block destroyed in a displacement event attributed to infrastructure reclamation; placed in Blessed Continuance Home
Begins first notebook; self-identifies as the neighborhood's historian
Discovers discarded dataslate with Palladian subsidiary transaction records relating to 2193 displacement
